actual_planning_risks.conditioning_limitation: Stages2/3 are unconditional marginal unions. They are not conditioned on surviving earlier chosen positions, and their summed negative logs are not a calibrated full-path death probability.
actual_planning_risks.hazard_event: At a proposed destination p at stage t, enemy occupancy at time t-1 OR time t; covers pre-enemy-move entry contact and post-enemy-move arrival.
actual_planning_risks.hidden_union: Poisson approximation with intensity before+after-before*P(stay at p).
actual_planning_risks.immediate_equivalence: First actions exclude currently visible occupied cells. Every allowed immediate destination is inside the observed neighborhood, so its before occupancy/intensity is zero; hazard[1] there should equal exported horizon1 occupancy in predictive mode. Validate numerically if selected. Future-stage hazards generally differ from occupancy.
actual_planning_risks.lookahead: Three action stages, weighted1.0/0.55/0.25, use -log(1-hazard) with a deadline/route-dependent risk multiplier55..100, then static path potential.
actual_planning_risks.route_cost: Uses exported horizon1 occupancy in a Dijkstra edge penalty16*risk plus visit cost and a5-unit currently visible occupancy penalty. Applying a fixed one-step map to distant traversal is a heuristic.
actual_planning_risks.visible_source_union: For each enemy source, before+after-before*P(stay at p); combines sources independently. This corrects within-enemy temporal overlap under the represented Markov law.

adaptive_state_audit.caveat: The exported slow_law and fast_law are normalized means; concentrations can change while those means remain fixed. Effective-law constancy alone does not audit every internal adaptive quantity. An inspected isolated diagnostic export can hash raw concentrations/log weights without changing source or actions if selected.

comparison_with_gen1: Both model anonymous attempted-direction dynamics with blocked attempts retaining staying mass; neither requires enemy IDs.
Gen1 has one fading expected-count law (retention0.965, count cap45). Gen4 introduces uniform/slow/fast experts, posterior-information weighting and likelihood-based expert adaptation.
Gen1 uses per-visible-cell background heuristics and horizons1/2. Gen4 propagates a diffuse hidden intensity, infers bounds and plans over three stages.

Gen1 combines before/after occupancy as independent events in its continuation heuristic. Gen4 subtracts the within-source stay intersection, improving internal event consistency while still lacking survival-conditioned path predictions.
Both expose a coherent fixed-uniform-law planning substitution; neither no_planning flag removes all predictive reasoning.

forecast_contract.action_conditioning: Enemy distributions are propagated independently of candidate path, assuming the current always-True interaction opens any adjacent unlocked door. No future observations, survival conditioning, future door interactions or wall changes are simulated.
forecast_contract.blocked_attempts: All nine attempted-direction probabilities retained; blocked destination or blocked diagonal side sends its mass to source.
forecast_contract.coordinates: Relative to starting agent position, inferred from cumulative observed displacement.
forecast_contract.exported_target: At least one enemy occupies a cell after the next enemy movement tick.

interventions.expected_matched_pair: no_planning versus frozen_no_planning should execute identical actions and full environment trajectories because both planners consume the same fixed-law outputs; verify actual hashes and map/localization state.

freeze.runtime_status: not yet tested for this source
freeze.source_coherence: _learn returns before forgetting, concentration updates and expert-weight updates. Other map/localization/occupancy computations still run. All three initial experts are uniform, giving a uniform effective law up to floating-point arithmetic.

interventions.frozen_vs_uniform_note: Frozen mixed-law arithmetic may differ from direct UNIFORM by rounding; do not presume exact action identity without checking.

prediction_use.name: uniform-law planning substitution, not removal of all prediction
prediction_use.runtime_status: not yet tested for this source
prediction_use.source_coherence: Planner recomputes both one-step occupancy risk and all three hazard maps under fixed uniform law, while retaining the same controller, map, bounds, visits and observed enemies. The learner/exported forecast continue updating.

lineage.relationship_to_gen1: Separate direct seed descendant; comparison below is architectural, not a claim that gen4 descends from gen1.

predictive_adaptation.effective_law: 0.12 uniform +0.88 likelihood-weighted mixture of uniform/slow/fast directional laws.
predictive_adaptation.expert_weighting: Discount log weights by0.95, restore0.05 times log expert prior(0.30,0.45,0.25), add0.70 times log current occupancy likelihood, then normalize.
predictive_adaptation.likelihood_qualification: Assignment enumeration permits multiple sources to end in one cell. Its exact likelihood is conditional on one enemy per previously visible occupied cell and the represented terrain; preexisting enemy overlaps and hidden state remain approximations.
predictive_adaptation.observations: Anonymous occupancy constraints on the prior center inner3 cells. Each previously visible occupied cell is one source; candidate directions that land on observed-empty safe cells are rejected and observed-occupied safe cells must be covered by the assignment union. Directions outside this safe region are censored.
state: log_weights: three expert mixture log weights
predictive_adaptation.updates: Posterior direction responsibilities are weighted by min(1,L1 distance from the prior expert law), so fully censored observations do not add concentration. updates/effective_updates count slow-expert informative sources/weights. Posterior concentrations also relax toward priors without informative sightings.
predictive_adaptation.wall_ticks: Likelihood updates skipped across a25-step wall-phase boundary; forgetting still runs unless learning is disabled.

risk_adapter_feasibility.full_adapter: For stage2/3, use an inspected isolated diagnostic accessor for risk/hazards and slow/fast/log_weights; preserve original executable source and verify actions/state before making causal claims. Alternatively reconstruct bounds and diffuse intensity from the observation history with source-specific validation.
risk_adapter_feasibility.immediate_adapter: A new source-hash-bound adapter can reconstruct chosen first-step risk from visible source positions, observed terrain/door geometry and attempted_movement_law; compare every reconstructed value against export and, through isolated instrumentation, hazards[1]. Uniform-law variants must separately score the probabilities used by planning.

state_estimation_separate_from_adaptatio.hidden_intensity: Remaining enemy count=3 minus number of visible occupied cells; density=hidden_count/max(45,130-free_visible), spread from unobserved traversable candidates. Candidate support is not normalized to a fixed total hidden count. Poisson survival approximates hidden occupancy.
state_estimation_separate_from_adaptatio.mapping: Terrain, seen times and inferred world bounds update from local observations independently of adaptive concentrations/weights.
state_estimation_separate_from_adaptatio.occupancy_representation: Every forecast resets visible source masses at currently observed occupied cells and constructs a fresh diffuse hidden intensity over remembered/nearby unseen cells. It does not maintain learned enemy identities or a persistent hidden occupancy filter.
state_estimation_separate_from_adaptatio.ordinary_memory: Visits, observed enemies, visible cells and previous-observation tuple continue updating; target and target_kind belong to controller memory.
